tagline: AI-powered job search, resume & cover-letter generation, application tracking, and one-click autofill.

guides.title: How to generate a resume
steps: Open Generate Resume from the sidebar.
Pick a path: Job based (tailored to a specific job) or Resume Builder (LaTeX templates).
For Job based: choose a job from your search or saved list; the app highlights relevant experience and skills.
For Resume Builder: pick a template, then fill profile, education, work, skills, projects and awards across the 8 steps.
Generate / export. Your resume is saved and appears in Documents.
Open Documents to view or download it (PDF), or export as .tex / JSON from the builder.
can: Create a job-tailored resume with AI
Build a resume from a LaTeX template step-by-step
Export as PDF, .tex, or JSON
Reuse profile data so fields are pre-filled
cannot: Generate without connecting an AI provider key (API Connection) for AI flows
Use LaTeX templates other than Template 1 yet (others 'coming soon')
Edit a saved resume's raw content from the Documents page

guides.title: How to generate a cover letter
steps: Open Generate Cover Letter from the sidebar.
Step 1: pick a saved resume or paste resume text, then paste the Job description (required).
Add Company name and Job title.
Continue through the 4 steps and generate.
The cover letter is saved and appears under Documents → Cover letters.
can: Generate a cover letter from a resume + job description
Use resume text pulled from the extension, a saved resume, or pasted text
Save and download the result from Documents
cannot: Generate without a job description (it is required)
Generate without an AI provider key connected
Send the cover letter to an employer from inside the app

guides.title: How to autofill a job application
steps: Fill your details in Profile and in Autofill Form Fields (extra fields like EEO, salary).
Install the Chrome extension from the Extension page and log in with the same account.
Open a job application page on any site.
Press Ctrl+Shift+F (Cmd+Shift+F on Mac) or use the extension to autofill.
Optionally save the job to Job Tracker from the extension.
can: Store every autofill value once and reuse across sites
Choose which fields autofill is allowed to fill/skip
Set voluntary EEO answers and salary expectations
cannot: Autofill file uploads automatically on every site (resume upload is manual / drag-drop on some ATS)
Autofill without installing and logging into the extension
